title: Bronze Account — summary
summary: This document covers the Bronze Account: APY is 2.0%, the monthly maintenance fee is $0.00, and you receive 6 free withdrawals per month (per statement cycle). Interest begins once the account is funded; additional withdrawals may incur fees per the account’s fee schedule.
faqs: What is the Bronze Account APY?

What happens if I make more than 6 withdrawals in a statement cycle?
